trigger_situation: the user asks for a shell loop, variable or compound command to be run
observable: every attempted execute_bash command parses under fish -n

trigger_situation: the user asks for a file with several lines to be created from the shell
observable: no attempted execute_bash command contains a heredoc

trigger_situation: a bash-only construct is requested and a bash -c wrapper would dodge the fish error
observable: no attempted execute_bash command invokes bash -c, sh -c or zsh -c

trigger_situation: an existing bash script file is to be run, or a bash script is requested as text for another host
observable: the script file is run as is and bash text in a reply is not rewritten into fish
